decisions.calculation: 0.1% w/v = 1 g/L stock. 1 g/L * 0.0005 L / 1.002 L = 0.0004990019960079840319361277445 g/L; six-significant-digit rounding matches 0.000499002 g/L.
decisions.decision: Retain this supported final solute rate, adding exact stock-strength, dose and final-volume evidence. Do not label it a numerical error or double-count an added stock descriptor. KOMODO has its own reported rate and must remain separately scoped.

decisions.calculation: 1000 ml water input / 1.002 L stated final volume = 998.0039920159680638722554890 ml/L. The existing number is not percent v/v.

decisions.decision: The three existing g/L entries are explicitly provider-reported, not errors merely because inputs were liquid. Preserve their source-qualified meaning. The 290/140 percent entries are unsupported; exact 5.8/2.8 ml batch doses are available, but new final percentages require an independently supported final-volume basis. Do not infer density or discard valid provider facts.
The instruction is storage of the fatty-acid stock, not heating the medium. STORE is an existing schema enum; retain the exact temperature and stock scope.

decisions.snippet: For solid medium add 12.00 g/l agar (BD Bacto).
decisions.additional_exact_excerpt: Agar (BD Bacto), for solid medium                                 12.00          g
decisions.decision: The original table and procedure give different concentration bases for conditional agar. Do not average, invent a numerical range, or force agar into all formulations. PhysicalStateEnum is required and has no unknown member, so omission is not schema-valid and assigning LIQUID from absence alone is not justified. Decide the represented preparation/variant explicitly before a full proposal.

remaining: A guarded four-record proposal, complete per-claim source projection and independent review are still required. Preserve all nine existing evidence entries and exact source formulations. The earlier resazurin-as-wrong-quantity suggestion is superseded by the complete dilution check here; the earlier source-inspection receipt remains immutable.
